newsitem.title: JAPAN: LTCB has 27.9 bln yen loans to Tokai Kogyo.
newsitem.headline: LTCB has 27.9 bln yen loans to Tokai Kogyo.

text.p: The Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd said on Monday it has 27.9 billion yen worth of outstanding loans to failed general contractor Tokai Kogyo Co Ltd, all of which may be unrecoverable.

The Long-Term Credit Bank (LTCB) said in a statement that while it would write off problem loans to Tokai Kogyo in the first half of 1997/98, the move would not have any major impact on its earnings estimates.
On Friday, Tokai Kogyo said it had filed for court protection from its creditors after abandoning a plan to rebuild its troubled business. Its debts totalled 511 billion yen.
In May, LTCB said it expected to post 10 billion yen in parent current profits in the first half of 1997/98 and 20 billion yen for the whole year.
